verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs explicitly state you can run CI/CD workflows using 'hosted or private runners' with 'no infrastructure needed', directly matching the story of platform-hosted runners without infra management. However, there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of hosted runner performance or limits, and no detail on runner types/specs. missing for 10: independent verification of hosted runner reliability/performance, detail on hosted runner specs/limits.
